table1.caveat: Virtual tokens balance hash-space ranges, not arbitrary hot-key traffic.

table1.technique: Vector clocks with reconciliation during reads
table1.paperAdvantage: Version size decoupled from update rates
table1.caveat: Clock entries grow with coordinating identities; pruning loses ancestry precision. Semantic reconciliation remains application work.

table1.paperAdvantage: Availability and durability when some replicas unavailable
table1.caveat: Thresholds may fail; disjoint participant sets break fixed-set overlap. Losing sole surviving acknowledged copy is irreversible.
Hashes locate differences; synchronization requires surviving values, eventual communication and reconciliation.

table1.technique: Gossip-based membership protocol and failure detection
table1.caveat: Administrative joins/leaves differ from local reachability suspicion. Seeds aid discovery, not leadership.

missingMechanisms: Exact Amazon retry schedules, context encoding, restart-safe clock allocation, membership race arbitration and balancing algorithm are not fully specified; teaching choices are labeled.
Capstone uses atomic macro-events for multi-message repair and confirmed transfer; request lab separately exposes persistence versus acknowledgement. No real network or database benchmark.
Controller formula, link delays and workload are synthetic. Original raw experimental samples unavailable.
Physical touch devices and screen-reader speech not directly tested; keyboard, labels and rendered layout checked.
numericalAnomalies: Version percentages sum to 99.94113%; remainder unexplained. Do not normalize.
Table 2 average improvement 2.35/2.12 ms conflicts with prose 3–4 ms. Preserve both.
